title: Commander4K item file (*.c4k)
description: One item: a view, a plugin, a panel, a link (open, url), a command (run) or an API request, and on a dashboard one tile. A folder with one .c4k file shows that item in its quick view and on Enter; with two or more it is a dashboard, one tile per file in natural name order (rename to reorder; at most 50 files of up to 256 KB). Shift+Enter always opens the plain file list. Comments and trailing commas are allowed.

title.description: Title of the view or tile; the file name without .c4k by default.

icon.description: An emoji shown when there is no image.

image.description: Picture file of the tile, relative to this file's folder.

plugin.description: Plugin id; installed from the official catalog when missing.

preview.description: The plugin's preview id (contributes.previews); the first one by default.

panel.description: Panel to open: a built-in id (builtin.sysinfo), the plugin's panel id with plugin, or <plugin>/<panel>.

open.description: Where Enter (or a click on the tile) goes: a relative folder, a file, an archive, \\server\share, sftp://user@host/dir, ftp://… Esc returns to the folder holding this file. For a card also what it shows.

user.description: User name for open on SFTP/FTP.

keyFile.description: Private key for open on SFTP; ~ is the user's profile.

url.description: http(s) page shown in the panel browser.

file.description: Markdown file for the markdown view (README.md by default).

folder.description: The folder the item is about (its context folder), relative to this file's folder or absolute; this file's folder by default. A card without open shows it (e.g. a mail account kept elsewhere).

options.description: Passed to the plugin as options (preview.render, panel.load, preview.card).

card.description: On a dashboard (2+ .c4k files in a folder), show this item as a live card: true = the preview Ctrl+Q would pick for open (or folder); or a name: files, gallery, notes, markdown, dashboard, api, ssh, the widgets clock, note, disks, a panel id (builtin.sysinfo, plugin/panel), or a plugin id (plugin or plugin/preview). Without card the item is a shortcut tile.

refresh.description: Read the card again every 10s, 5m, 1h… while the dashboard is visible (at least 2 s).

size.description: Footprint on the dashboard grid (columns × rows): small 1×1, wide 2×1, tall 1×2, large 2×2, huge 3×2, full = the whole row.

view.description: settings, skins and plugins are the app's own pages (settings, skins, plugin manager); the app writes settings.c4k, skins.c4k and plugins.c4k into config/, config/skins/ and the plugins folder.

run.description: A command started in the item's folder after the user trusts this file (trust covers run, api, ssh and remote card fields, so renaming the title or resizing keeps it). A .ps1 runs with PowerShell 7.

cwd.description: Working folder relative to this folder.

api.description: An HTTP request. {secret:name} in a header or the body (not the url) is replaced with a secret stored by the app (never write tokens here). Methods other than GET/HEAD need the user's trust in this file.

path.description: Path in the JSON response: a.b, items[0].name, $ for the whole value.

ok.description: For status: values that mean good.
